naming_rule: Initial assignment only: lowercase snake_case(provider_id + method + path_template), truncated to 55 characters and stripped of trailing underscore, followed by underscore and first 8 hex characters of api_id. The maintenance script fills only NULL public_mcp_tool_name values and preserves all assigned names; on a collision, extend only the new UUID suffix to 12, 16, then 32 hex characters and shorten the prefix to keep the total <=64. PostgreSQL enforces uniqueness. The MCP service reads the stored value without regenerating it.
